message.content: On February 24, 1815, the young sailor Edmond Dantès returns to Marseilles as acting captain of the *Pharaon* after the death of Captain Leclère, delighting his employer M. Morrel with his skill and honesty—while secretly having delivered a packet and encountered Napoleon at Elba—only to face suspicion from the envious supercargo Danglars, setting the stage for his tragic downfall.
